name: Desert Detectors
desc:
💎 Welcome to Desert Detectors💎

Embark on a treasure-hunting adventure with Desert Detectors, where your trusty metal detector leads the way to uncover hidden relics and riches!

[How To Dig]
• Equip your metal detector and explore the desert to locate treasure hotspots.
• Hold down [LMB] to charge your dig, then release to strike the ground.
• Wait to see exclamation points that are found while detecting!
• Find fossils, skulls, meteors, submarines, diamonds, jewels, mummies, and more!

Inspired by: Fisch
